The plan acknowledges the silent-degradation problem explicitly but adds no instrumentation to surface it.
findings.location: Approach step 1; Scope section (transport.py); AC — 'the acceptance bar is NOT no AttributeError'
scenarios: A DC deployment silently fails to sync issue links or parent relationships (permission denied on the DC instance); the operator sees a green reconcile pass and believes the sync is complete.
A DC write fails due to a transient network partition; the exception is swallowed, no log is emitted, and the operator has no way to detect the partial write.
A quota/rate-limit on the DC REST API causes all property writes to fail silently; the reconciler reports convergence while the properties are never written.
